instruction: A candid documentary photograph, full shot from a low angle. In an indoor martial arts dojo with a brick wall background and wooden floor, the boy in the white gi (R2) sits cross-legged in the foreground with his back to the camera, watching the demonstration. In the background, the man in the black gi (R6) stands facing right, executing a high side kick with his right leg raised high and body tilted. Bright natural light streams from the right side, casting long, sharp diagonal shadows across the wooden floor, creating a focused training atmosphere.
